big: A PMS holds 15 stocks and two fall by half. The portfolio takes a big hit. A PMS can be concentrated and expensive, so check before committing: concentration, benchmark, track record and exit load.

lines: One PMS had a great year. Should that decide it?
No. One strong year says little. Look at five years and at market falls. Compare with a benchmark such as the Nifty 500. Check concentration and read the exit load terms.
